scientific_intent.primary_domain: Dense least-squares and linear system primitives
scientific_intent.scientific_task: Solve batched linear systems via a least-squares vendor interface, checking real and complex precision behavior.
scientific_intent.governing_method: Batched GELS least-squares interface; measured square full-rank fixture reduces to exact linear solving.
accuracy_needs: Full complex modulus error, not real part of squared error
Separate source expected-one rounding discrepancy from solution error
